description: This file defines the TailscaleNetwork enum with static methods to identify Tailnet IPv4 addresses and detect such addresses from network interfaces.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if a given IPv4 address string belongs to the Tailnet IPv4 range (100.x.x.x with specific octet constraints).

methods.name: detectTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Iterates over network interface IPv4 addresses to find and return a Tailnet IPv4 address, if any.
